newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila oil group in farm-out with Australia Socdet.
newsitem.headline: Manila oil group in farm-out with Australia Socdet.

text.p: Philippine oil consortium led by Alcorn Production Philippines Inc. (APPI) will sign on September 23 a farm-out agreement with Australia-based Socdet Management Limited for a 35 percent stake in Service Contract 14 in the oil province of Northwest Palawan.
APPI vice-president Mario Uson said that Socdet has completed its due diligence work and has decided to undertake a $6 million, three-dimensional seismic program in exchange for the 35 percent stake.
Uson said that should Socdet decide to drill an optional well after the survey, then it will earn another 25 percent participating interest.

Last June 25, the Alcorn-led consortium signed an agreement with Socdet which stated that Socdet has two months from the signing of the agreement to conduct due diligence work and decide whether or not to proceed with the farm-in.

Members of the Service Contract 14 are Alcorn Production & Minerals Corp, Alcorn Philippines Inc, Oriental Petroleum & Minerals Corp, Basic Petroleum & Minerals Inc, Petrofields Exploration & Development Co Inc, Seafront Resources Corp, Philippine Overseas Drilling Corp, Unioil and Gas Development Co, Balabac Oil Exploration and Drilling Co, Pacific Rim Oil and Resources Inc PR.PS, TransAsia Oil and Mineral Development Corp, Vulcan Industrial Mining Corp and local firm Alsons Consolidated.
Uson said that of the consortium members, Oriental has not yet decided on whether to join the farm-out.
